title: Page last modified executor
description: Writes a JSON file that maps page routes to the date of the last Git commit that changed each page's source file.

pages.description: Pages to date, each a route and the source file or files the page is generated from.

route.description: Route of the page, for example /about. A route with one :param segment, for example /dataset/:datasetId, creates one route per source file, named after the file without its extension.

source.description: Source file or glob relative to the workspace root, for example apps/portal/public/assets/datasets/*.json. Only files tracked by Git are used. When a route without a :param matches several files, it gets the latest date.

outputFile.description: JSON file to write, relative to the workspace root, for example apps/portal/public/page-last-modified.json.
